decisions.rationale: Roofless ruined chapel 9 x 20 m: buttressed side walls broken at 1.4-7.8 m with lancet gaps, a tall broken west gable with its great window open, a collapsed east end with a doorway and a rubble floor; 1,238 triangles, 101,336 bytes before meshopt. Everything stays inside its collider below 3 m and within 0.8 m above it (world-assets footprint test); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Window and door openings are plain rectangles; no tracery, mouldings or sills.
Masonry is the castle surface layer tiled every 3 m and the moss layer every 2 m; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decal per piece.

decisions.rationale: In the Old Cloister and the Drowned Archive, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss, with shadows on the level castle ground. The sightline cutaway shows the hero through it (castle browser suite: 100% of hero pixels visible behind a citadel curtain with the cutaway, 0.4% without), and a camera inside its bounds plus 2 m hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Castles and ruins are scenery: no doors open, no interiors and no reachable walls or towers.
